# Harbor Cloud service terms

These terms apply to your use of Harbor Cloud, the managed hosting service
provided by Harbor Labs AB ("Harbor").

## 1. The service

Harbor Cloud runs the applications you deploy to it in the region you choose.
Harbor operates and maintains the servers that run Harbor Cloud.

## 2. Availability

Harbor aims to keep Harbor Cloud available 99.9% of each calendar month.
Service credits for missed availability are set out in the Service Level
Agreement.

## 3. Your data

You keep all rights in the data your applications store. Harbor processes it
only to provide Harbor Cloud.
